description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it, Genesis Chamber and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cat and Myr, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.
